weight_mapping_basis: User-approved time-versus-money experiment design; not a claim that the transcript states these exact dimensions.
normalization: Min-max within the same feasible candidate set for one decision scenario.
hard_constraints: Exclude unreachable, invalid, illegal, or incomplete routes before scoring.

segment_accounting.energy: Retain signed EV v2 energy per ordered road Link and journey segment.
segment_accounting.electricity_billing: Sum signed Link net energy at the journey-segment boundary; bill max(segment_net_kWh, 0) times an explicit electricity rate.
segment_accounting.fare_attribution: Deadhead revenue is known zero. Record observed passenger fare once on the passenger segment; allocate per Link only under an explicit per-kilometre fare schedule.
segment_accounting.net_cost: Sum priced costs in the declared scope minus known segment fare revenue.
segment_accounting.api_compute: Record measured usage and matching rates separately at decision or method level; never duplicate a shared charge across route candidates or Links.
segment_accounting.unknown_value_policy: Keep unknown fare, tariff, usage, and rate as null. Block net-cost scoring when required inputs for the declared scope are missing or incomparable.
segment_accounting.scope_policy: A vehicle-operating-cost score excludes API and compute cost explicitly; do not label it full experiment economic cost or profit.

meeting_transcript_context.existing_project_interpretation: Distance-based fare revenue was discussed against electricity and token/API expense; the weight pairs in that passage were not unambiguously time-versus-money weights.
meeting_transcript_context.fare_rate_status: Illustrative only; not a frozen tariff or default.

reporting_limits: A single feasible candidate cannot establish a weight-driven route-choice change.
Full profitability is not established without depreciation, maintenance, insurance, tolls, taxes, and all other in-scope costs.
Energy is simulated unless supported by vehicle telemetry.
